parameters.name: HE160
parameters.description: Indicates support for High Efficiency (HE) 160 MHz.

parameters.name: HE8080
parameters.description: Indicates support for HE 80+80 MHz.

parameters.name: MCSNSS
parameters.description: Supported High Efficiency-Modulation and Coding Scheme (HE-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in {{bibref|802.11ax|Figure 9-788d}} Supported HE-MCS And NSS Set field format. HE-MCS And NSS Set field for 160MHz is present if 160MHz is supported. HE-MCS And NSS Set field for 80+80MHz is present if 80+80MHz is supported.

parameters.name: SUBeamformer
parameters.description: Indicates support for Single-User (SU) Beamformer.

parameters.name: SUBeamformee
parameters.description: Indicates support for SU Beamformee.

parameters.name: MUBeamformer
parameters.description: Indicates support for Multi-User (MU) Beamformer.

parameters.name: Beamformee80orLess
parameters.description: Indicates support for Beamformee Space-Time Stream (STS) ≤ 80 MHz.

parameters.name: BeamformeeAbove80
parameters.description: Indicates support for Beamformee STS > 80 MHz.

parameters.name: ULMUMIMO
parameters.description: Indicates support for Uplink (UL) Multi-User Multiple Input, Multiple Output (MU-MIMO).

parameters.name: ULOFDMA
parameters.description: Indicates support for UL Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDMA).

parameters.name: DLOFDMA
parameters.description: Indicates support for Downlink (DL) Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDMA).

parameters.name: MaxDLMUMIMO
parameters.description: Max number of users supported per DL MU-MIMO Transmitter (TX) in the BSS role.

parameters.name: MaxULMUMIMO
parameters.description: Max number of users supported per UL MU-MIMO Receiver (RX) in the BSS role.

parameters.name: MaxDLOFDMA
parameters.description: Max number of users supported per Downlink (DL) OFDMA TX in the BSS role.

parameters.name: MaxULOFDMA
parameters.description: Max number of users supported per UL OFDMA RX in the BSS role.

parameters.name: RTS
parameters.description: Indicates support for Request To Send (RTS).

parameters.name: MURTS
parameters.description: Indicates support for MU RTS.

parameters.name: MultiBSSID
parameters.description: Indicates support for Multi-Basic Service Set Identifier (BSSID).

parameters.name: MUEDCA
parameters.description: Indicates support for MU Enhanced distributed channel access (EDCA).

parameters.name: TWTRequestor
parameters.description: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) Requestor.

parameters.name: TWTResponder
parameters.description: Indicates support for TWT Responder.

parameters.name: SpatialReuse
parameters.description: Indicates support for EasyMesh configuration and reporting of BSS Color and Spatial Reuse.

parameters.name: AnticipatedChannelUsage
parameters.description: Indicates support for Anticipated Channel Usage (ACU) reporting.

object.description: Describes the Wi-Fi 6 capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).
